label: Controls for the typed LORD_3 reading and the intellectual-recipient premise
paraphrase: Closed controls on two two-being interpretations (Bool; true is GOD_4, causes the being of and governs false). With false intellectual: (1) nonvacuity: with willing and true LORD_1, the restricted willing premise and 'Whatever is LORD_3 is LORD_1' hold and true is LORD_3 and LORD_1; (2) strictness: with no willing and nothing LORD_1, 'Whatever is LORD_3 is LORD_1' holds and 'Whatever is LORD_2 is LORD_1' fails; (3) sense mixing: with willing and nothing LORD_1, true is LORD_3 and not LORD_1; (4) necessity of willing: with no willing, true is LORD_2 and not LORD_3. With only true intellectual and no willing: (5) the restricted willing premise, the q.5 a.1 coextension and the strong (exclusive) ordered-love variant 1dd68893, an unattributed analyst strengthening of ad 3 (rational read as having intellect), hold, while 'Every GOD_4 wills some GOOD_4 to every being in act in esse' and CausalExistenceWilling fail. Statements about these interpretations only.
